non_goals: The weekly digest Competitor Delta line (separate ticket in map #528)
Named rival storage + settings UI (#546 — blocked by this migration only)
Pagination beyond the top ~20 (page 1 only, zero extra quota)
Per-competitor detail or review lookups (extra SerpAPI calls)
place_id-rotation continuity logic — data_cid is stored write-only in v1, no code reads it
Fixing the stale SERPAPI_PREFILL_COST_USD constant (research follow-up, not this ticket)
Merging the research/serpapi-competitor-fields docs branch (map-level loose end, surfaced separately)

user_visible_behavior: No direct UI change. Observable: after each ranking-tracking run, competitor_snapshots holds the full pack for that (business, keyword, search_location, snapshot_date)

Mock mode (MOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS=true) synthesizes a deterministic-ish pack (fake rivals + is_self row at the mocked rank) through the same write path, so downstream #546/digest work is developable locally
invariants: Zero marginal SerpAPI calls — the pack comes from the response resolveRankPosition already fetches; budget-guard behavior (checkRateLimit strict) unchanged

Own-rank upsert + pack delete + pack insert run in ONE sql.begin() transaction; a pack failure rolls back the rank row and fails the job (BullMQ retry converges — replace-pack + rank upsert are both idempotent)
Replace-pack idempotency: DELETE by (business_id, keyword, snapshot_date) then bulk INSERT — no per-row upsert key (place_id can be NULL)
Full pack persisted: entries missing place_id/rating/reviews are kept with NULLs, never dropped
is_self row included when the own business appears in the pack; absent otherwise (absence is a ranking fact)

Tenant scoping: every read/write on competitor_snapshots scoped by business_id; table registered in scripts/ci/tenant-tables.ts; RLS owner_select policy mirroring migration 035's ranking_snapshots policy
Subscription strict-active guard, outbox completion contract, and 1-keyword cap unchanged
Competitor packs are purged with the account: offboarding disposition hard_delete/direct_business_id/must_be_absent, deletable + verified by business (mirrors ranking_snapshots)
edge_cases: Entry lacking place_id → persisted with NULL place_id, is_self=false
Own business absent from pack (rank null) → pack still persisted, no is_self row
Budget exhausted before the call → no SerpAPI call, no pack write (existing break behavior)
Owner edits ranking_search_location → new rows carry the new value; old rows keep theirs; the series breaks by design (#532 Q6 lock: comparisons filter on same keyword + search_location)
Same-day re-run → whole pack replaced atomically, no duplicate rows
Empty local_results (rank not found, zero entries) → DELETE runs with zero inserts: that date's pack is cleared, recording the empty-pack fact
Entry missing position → array index + 1 fallback (existing own-rank behavior, applied per pack row)
Mock mode → synthetic pack flows through the identical transaction path
